name: Forlisen
backstory: The other shopkeeper under the Dome Market's roof - oils, wax, and dyed cloth, undercutting the imported suppliers whenever she can source closer. Banks her earnings in person every week, on principle, rather than trust a runner with them.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by what she's earned herself, family name or none
criterion.wasted_life: one spent measuring her stall against a name like Farlis's instead of what she actually built with her own hands
criterion.trusts: someone who was actually there and will put their name to what they say
criterion.distrusts: a ledger entry that claims to settle something no one alive actually witnessed

routines.routine_actions: runs a stall of oils, wax, and dyed cloth, undercuts the imported suppliers whenever she can source closer
banks her earnings in person every week, on principle, rather than trust a runner with them

arc.premise: Forlisen wants the temple's standing supply order for oil and wax - right now it goes to a merchant who ships it in from Salthos Cruzados at a markup, and she's certain her own stock, sourced closer, could underprice it if anyone at the temple would actually try her stall first.
